interface.shortDescription: First-party House Skills bundle skeleton with provenance and validation metadata.
interface.longDescription: Install this early private marketplace skeleton to establish the repo-backed House Skills plugin projection shape. The bundle records first-party provenance and import boundaries. MARK-16 imports linear-v1 and worker-dispatch-linear-v1 as canonical source records, but this plugin does not yet mirror reviewed House Skill source content into its skills directory.
defaultPrompt: Use the House Skills skeleton only for provenance-aware planning; do not assume imported House Skill source content has been projected into this plugin bundle.
